question: Which of the following won the highest number of gold medals in the 36th national games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Services Sports Control Board**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Services Sports Control Board (SSCB)** emerged as the top performer in the 36th National Games held in Gujarat, winning the highest number of gold medals.
 
• SSCB secured a total of **128 medals**, which included 61 gold, 35 silver, and 32 bronze medals.
 
• The Services contingent has consistently dominated the National Games, showcasing excellence in various sports disciplines over the years.
 
• The 36th National Games took place in Gujarat from **September 29 to October 12, 2022**, featuring athletes from across India.
 
• SSCB represents athletes from the Indian Armed Forces, highlighting the role of disciplined training and physical fitness in their success.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Games of India**

 
 
• The National Games is a multi-disciplinary sporting event held in India, similar to the Olympics, featuring athletes from all states and union territories.
 
• The first modern National Games were held in **Lahore in 1924** as the Indian Olympic Games.
 
• The event is organized by the Indian Olympic Association (IOA).
 
• The National Games serve as a platform for spotting and nurturing talent for international sports events.
 
 
 
• **Services Sports Control Board (SSCB)**
 
 
• SSCB is an apex sports body in India representing the Indian Armed Forces in national and international sports competitions.
 
• It is known for producing elite athletes in sports like boxing, wrestling, shooting, and athletics.
 
• The board emphasizes rigorous training, discipline, and infrastructure for sports development.
 
 
 
• **Top Performers at the 36th National Games**
 
 
• While SSCB topped the medal tally, other prominent states included **Maharashtra** and **Haryana**, which also won a significant number of medals.
 
• Maharashtra secured second place with 140 medals, including 39 golds.
 
• Haryana followed in third place, excelling in wrestling and boxing.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the National Games**
 
 
• The event promotes a culture of sports and fitness in India, aligning with initiatives like **Fit India Movement**.
 
• It provides a platform for grassroots athletes to compete at the national level.
 
• Medalists at the National Games often represent India in global competitions like the Olympics and Asian Games.
